reference: DisGeNET v7 all associations, exact disease CUI; common eligible gene universe within each cohort.
selection: Prespecified top 500 BRIDGE and matched DE genes; three existing disease cohorts only.
validation: All six odds ratios and right-sided Fisher p-values reconstructed from saved contingency counts; BH correction over six primary tests reproduced.
comparison_scope: Per-list enrichment versus background, not a direct BRIDGE–DE significance test. Not an exact replication of the original paper’s 25 comparisons or reference filtering.
